# Command reference {#commands}

The commands of the `tok` program, their options, their output for programs (`--json`) and their exit codes. The Python package adds one command of its own, `tok mcp`, which runs the MCP server for AI agents ([Chapter 14](#agents)):

```
tok mcp              # serve one MCP client on standard input and output
tok mcp --version    # print the version of the server
```
